title: DNA Extraction with Heater Shaker - Part 2
author: Opentrons
materials: Samples + controls transferred to magnetic module
Samples + controls moved to fresh plate

steps.title: Set aspiration parameters and split reagents
steps.instruction: Configure the aspiration height field for transfers from the heater shaker to the magnetic module, set the aspiration rate to 10 % of the default, and divide the total calculated volume of each reagent equally between the indicated column pairs (reagent 4 across columns 4 & 5, reagent 5 across columns 6 & 7, reagent 6 across columns 8 & 9) because the protocol will alternate between the two columns as the source.

substeps.instruction: Set aspiration height for heater‑shaker → magnetic‑module transfer.
Set aspiration rate to 10 % of default.
Split reagent 4 volume equally between columns 4 and 5.
Split reagent 5 volume equally between columns 6 and 7.
Split reagent 6 volume equally between columns 8 and 9.

steps.title: Transfer samples and controls to magnetic module
steps.instruction: Move all samples and their corresponding controls from the heater shaker to the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add 240 µL reagent from column 4
steps.instruction: Pipette 240 µL of the reagent located in column 4 of the reagent plate into the appropriate wells on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well after the reagent addition step.

steps.title: Perform two washes using columns 5‑6
steps.instruction: Carry out two successive wash steps using the reagents from columns 5 and 6 of the reagent plate.

substeps.instruction: First wash: add the wash reagent from column 5, incubate as required, then remove supernatant.
Second wash: add the wash reagent from column 6, incubate as required, then remove supernatant.

steps.title: Add 30 µL reagent from column 7
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of the reagent located in column 7 of the reagent plate to each sample and control well.

steps.title: Transfer samples and controls to fresh plate
steps.instruction: Move the processed samples and controls from the magnetic module to a fresh plate for downstream applications.
